title: Investigate European dynamic transfer reachability
changes: Identify the original dynamic transfer guest gate and its enabling and disabling callback instructions, and document the remaining ordinary-use criterion.
validation: Fourteen authenticated EUR catalog snapshots show no ready selector or gate; decoded DS20 registers and IWRAM match a retained Wine inspection. An initially invalid region-hash scan was corrected and retained separately.

An isolated Windows audit build and one Wine observation of the existing 320-frame Party Unit route show no dynamic-span bus reads or sampled target dispatch hits, with zero dropped events and protected inputs unchanged.
limitations: This bounded negative cannot prove global absence: native dispatch sampling may miss intra-block changes and bus audit excludes folded constants and unselected host reads. Ordinary positive use and full-state/clock comparison remain open; Linux, USA and native Windows pending; no performance measurement.
